# Design Monks

> AI-powered design agency specializing in UI/UX, branding, and web design across Figma, Framer, and Webflow platforms.

Design Monks is a full-service design agency founded by Atiqur Rahaman and Abdullah Al Noman, offering premium design services for web, mobile, and SaaS products. With a global presence across Mount Arlington NJ, Australia, and South Africa, they combine strategic design thinking with modern tools to deliver user-centric solutions.

## Key Topics

- UI/UX Design

## Core Services

- [All Services Overview](https://www.designmonks.co/services): Main services page covering UI/UX, branding, web design via Figma, Webflow
- [UI/UX Design Services](https://www.designmonks.co/services/ui-ux): Specialized UI/UX design service page for responsive product design
- [Logo & Branding Services](https://www.designmonks.co/services/logo-branding): Logo design and brand identity service offering custom branding solutions
- [Web Design Services](https://www.designmonks.co/services/web-design): Web design service focused on UX, speed, and conversion optimization
- [SaaS UI/UX Design](https://www.designmonks.co/services/saas-design): SaaS-focused UI/UX design service for scalable platform experiences

## Design Platform Expertise

- [Webflow Design Agency](https://www.designmonks.co/services/webflow-design): Webflow design & development service featuring Startio and MonksHub
- [Framer Design Agency](https://www.designmonks.co/services/framer-design): Framer design agency specializing in responsive, SEO-optimized websites

## Project Portfolio & Case Studies

- [All Projects & Portfolios](https://www.designmonks.co/projects): Showcase of 15+ design projects including Dwelio, Trackory, Materio & ESDIAC
- [Triply - Travel Booking App](https://www.designmonks.co/projects/triply-plan-book-travel): Case study: Triply adventure travel booking app with intuitive UI/UX
- [The Plate - Restaurant Booking](https://www.designmonks.co/projects/food-ordering-mobile-app-design): Case study: Plate restaurant booking app with AI recommendations
- [Yenex - Renewable Energy Dashboard](https://www.designmonks.co/projects/navigating-the-future-of-distributed-energy-systems): Case study: Yenex renewable energy dashboard for distributed systems
- [Fitmate - Fitness Tracking App](https://www.designmonks.co/projects/enhancing-fitness-for-australians): Case study: Fitmate fitness tracker with AI-powered workout personalization
- [Zantrik - Vehicle Management App](https://www.designmonks.co/projects/zantrik-intuitive-vehicle-management-solution): Case study: Zantrik vehicle management app redesign with gamification
